4th Period.connections: Your AI article is published — that closes out our literacy detour. Today we start the unit that runs the rest of the semester: rebuilding Mario one design pattern at a time. First up is the state machine, the pattern behind every character who can be in one mode or another. Tomorrow you write the code that actually flips Mario between them.
